title: String-Concatenated SQL Queries
pattern: Concatenating raw, untrusted user strings into query templates instead of using parameter bindings.
why_bad: It exposes the application to SQL injection attacks, where malicious actors can manipulate the command structure, leading to data exfiltration or loss [13:104].
detection: Dynamic query string construction containing variable formatting of non-vetted strings, immediately passed to query compilation API sinks [13:104].
fix: Use typed query parameters or parameterized placeholder bindings exclusively [13:104].
source: *Building Secure and Reliable Systems* (Adkins), Chapter 12 [13:104]; *Code Complete* (McConnell), Chapter 8 [28:214].
